title: scenario
description: One recorded run of a trigger: the seed and generated input, the stubbed results of every effectful node, and the report the run produced. wilanis fuzz writes them; wilanis regress replays them and diffs node by node.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/scenario.schema.json.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

trigger.description: The trigger this run fired. A scenario replays a way in, not an implementation: the binding chosen under the profile decides which graphs actually run.

stubs.description: dotted node path -> the value its operation returned.
